messages.author: Ramachandran, Balajee
messages.body:
Dear all
I have performed the mds in namd and have .dcd file.  The aim of the study is to compute free energy (mmpbsa). The complex contains methylated histidine, and adp.  When converting from NAMD to Amber, it doesnt recognizes the bond between the histidine NE2 and CH3.  In addition to this, how to convert the ADP from namd to amber since we assign through GAFF in amber.
Could anyone please suggest how to convert this complex from NAMD to compute in Ambertools.
Your suggestions are welcome!
Thanks and regards
Balajee

messages.author: Vlad Cojocaru
messages.body:
What force field are you using in NAMD prior to Amber and what force
field are you planning to use in Amber for the mmpbsa calculations ?
If you do not have ff parameters for the methylated histidine compatibe
with the Amber ff, you need to generate them before. If there are
parameters published in the literature, you can just load those.
Hope this helps
Vlad

messages.author: Ramachandran, Balajee
messages.body:
Dear Friends
Could you please help me how to convert the NAMD files to Amber.  I want to compute the dG values using the Ambertools
FYI, I have applied this command but it is not working for me.  Please suggest with the correct commands.
chamber -top <rtf> -param <prm> -psf <psf>
Earlier I tried with applying the -cmap, but it throws the error (given below)
Action chamber failed
UnhandledArgumentWarning: -cmap
Thank you, Expecting the reply at the earliest
regards
Balajee

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Jul 14, 2023, Ramachandran, Balajee via AMBER wrote:
>
>FYI, I have applied this command but it is not working for me.  Please
>suggest with the correct commands.
>
>chamber -top <rtf> -param <prm> -psf <psf>
You should use the chamber action inside parmed, not the stand-alone
program.  But in any case, to get any help you need to say more than "it
doesn't work" -- we need to know some information about what happened.
....dac

regards
Balajee
